source.note: Synthetic ground truth. The FIRST series has no Lactose bar -- the absence is part of the record, not a zero. Capturing this without declared category ticks makes the second series' Lactose bar take a neighbour's name.

calibration.categoryAxisNote: c1/c2 are the two ends of the CATEGORY axis: the OUTER EDGE of the first and last category band. MEASURED off the figure from the bars themselves - the first and last bar (or group) centre, extended by half the pitch - NOT the plot box. They differ: on this figure the plot spines sit outside the category extent, and using them puts every band boundary far enough off to cut through a bar. c2 carries how many categories the figure draws.
